name: Foggy Path
description: A treacherous, fog-choked trail winding through Driftmoor's outskirts, used by the Driftkin to test their young. The air pulses with eerie mist, obscuring gnarled trees and jagged rocks. Faint howls echo as fog-mutated wolves stalk their prey, their eyes glowing faintly in the haze.

stages.description: The trail's entrance, shrouded in thick fog. A pair of fog-mutated wolves emerge from the mist, their movements unnervingly silent.
Deeper into the path, the fog grows denser, warping sounds and shapes. A fog-touched scavenger, driven mad by the mist, joins a wolf in an erratic ambush.
The heart of the Foggy Path, where the mist swirls with unnatural energy. A pack of fog-mutated wolves, led by a massive alpha, guards a glowing fog-shard embedded in the ground.
